summary: A Woodbridge family dental office with implants and cosmetic care is a strength, but dead booking buttons and no office hours appear to cost you patients.

findings.problem: Book An Appointment appears three times and Book A Consultation appears twice, all linking to #, and no working online booking appears.
findings.cost: A patient ready to book hits a dead button and may leave.
findings.fix: One working booking form behind every button.

findings.problem: No office hours appear, and emergency dentistry appears featured with no after hours process.
findings.cost: Patients in pain cannot tell when or how to reach you.
findings.fix: Visible hours and a clear emergency process.

findings.problem: A review appears to say 'replying on a Sunday', the text appears to include a missing space ('Vaughan,Woodbridge'), and the header appears to serve Woodbridge and Vaughan while the body lists many more areas.
findings.cost: Typos and mixed service areas weaken a clinic's care image.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and one clear service area.

findings.problem: The before and after slider appears to show one image pair, testimonials appear with initials only, and the claim 'leading dentist' appears with no data.
findings.cost: Thin proof gives a new patient little reason to choose you.
findings.fix: Real cases, ratings and named reviews.
